data.body: SCOPE_DISTINCTION: 170b-2ac9 is the MVP slice of e407-d35c, covering commit-level source attribution via git-native trailers only (DSO-Skill, DSO-Agent, DSO-Task, DSO-Story, DSO-Epic, DSO-Model, DSO-Review-Score trailers in /dso:commit). It does NOT include: /dso:blame command, bug investigation trailer queries, retro analytics, review context enrichment, or detailed telemetry logs. Those features remain in-scope for the parent epic e407-d35c (open). 170b-2ac9 is now closed (delivered); e407-d35c is the next-phase work.
